scope: Live Push output through shared CLI parser, captured display limits and full raw recovery. Full application/distribution incomplete.

Not a full-suite rerun.

No real network progress cadence claimed.

Includes real success/rejection/hook rejection, three close policies, captured once-only post-actions, cancellation/missing presenter, superproject and Fetch presets; real partial all-remotes publication and count-after-deletion refresh; native Log first-parent lanes and captured Push count setting.
verification.implementation: Optional observer forwarded only to actual push branch/tag commands and count; final raw output remains unchanged. AsyncStream coalesces wake-ups with parser-held bytes; source CR/local/remote rules and soft presentation limit, ANSI removal, green percentage/phase and automatic end scrolling. Complete raw diagnostics classify rejection independently of truncated display. Structured GitFailure enables concise failure summary without replaying live output. Legacy no-result completion retains raw path. Cross-stream ordering is sampled, not a strict chronological merge.

Bundle audits passed Finder extension, 98 original icons, licenses, universal EditorConfig/IssueRegex; Store Git 2.55.0 has 11 universal Mach-O files and passed local fixtures. Source inventory remains 3,277 seven-column LF data rows. Site uses existing real screenshots, which predate streaming; no new displayed capture or hosted deployment.
